title: LeafCutter
description: Allows you to instantly break leaves using shears. Lightweight, fast, and compatible with Paper 1.21+.
body:
LeafCutter is a lightweight and straightforward plugin that allows players to instantly break leaves using shears.

🔹 Compatible with Paper 1.21+
🔹 No external dependencies
🔹 Ideal for survival and vanilla‑like servers
🔹 Simple configuration and production‑ready

📂 Just drop the .jar file into the plugins folder and restart your server.
